title: Unified Tendril Language
purpose: Retire the separate free-space blue trail language so the Core's three open-space appendages and three surface contacts read as one suction-tendril anatomy changing state.
allowedScope: free-space Core tendril geometry and animation
build telemetry describing the unified visual family
forbiddenScope: player translation, rotation, force, collision, or boundary ownership
new tendril controls or locomotion authority
Grave octave, resonance, rupture, consequence, route, exit, or progression changes
stateGrammar: drift: relaxed tapered tendon with folded sucker
handoff: free anatomy fades as surface-contact anatomy reaches
reach: contact owner extends same tendon family toward authored surface
seal: sucker opens/flattens at the authored surface
peel: sucker stays planted while tendon lifts, then returns to drift
visualTargets: no legacy cone/ribbon travel veils remain on the player Core
free-space and attached tendrils share shaft/root/sucker color and material family
free-space tips look like folded versions of the surface sucker
exactly three locomotor tendrils are implied across free and attached states, not six simultaneous limbs
open-space motion reads as relaxed limbs rather than exhaust, ribbons, or decorative whiskers
acceptanceTests: a still frame in open space reads as three relaxed appendages capable of attaching
approaching a surface reads as the same appendages transitioning from drift to reach/seal
surface attachment does not visually double the limb count
movement feel and controls are unchanged from HC031E1
